data.name: Into the Fire
data.detailed_description:
Set out on a dark adventure in the shadow of an erupting volcano. Rescue people and animals while battling the wrath of nature and the spirits of fire in Into the Fire, a cataclysm extraction survival set in a dangerous world shaken by natural disaster.

RACE AGAINST TIME

Nature has turned against humanity, but not all is lost. Venture into the very heart of hell to save yourself and others. As ash clouds swallow entire districts, pyroclastic flows surge without warning, and earthquakes split the ground beneath your feet, every extraction becomes a race against time.

Carry the wounded through collapsing structures, clear paths through fire, collapsing buildings, and secure escape routes before lava seals them forever. Volcanic bombs drop from the sky, temperatures rise, and every second counts. You are not here to conquer nature. You are here to pull someone back from it.

Every decision in the field affects who survives and what your HUB becomes.

  • Cataclysm extraction survival focused on rescuing others.

  • A dynamic volcanic disaster reshapes the levels.

  • Time pressure and limited resources create real tension.

BUILD YOUR BASE

The HUB is not just a menu - it is a living settlement shaped by the people you rescue. Survivors bring skills, knowledge, and possibilities: from new gear and armor, better extinguishing equipment, or improved extraction systems. You also find items that restore hope. You reunite friends and families, and each mission can bring you closer to evacuation.

Your HUB grows or collapses based on who you can save. 

  • Survivors directly impact hub progression.

  • New tools, missions, and systems are unlocked through rescue.

  • The hub reflects your success or your failures.

PLAN.RISK. EXTRACT

Every mission begins with preparation — and rarely goes according to plan. Monitor your water level, track temperature spikes, manage scarce supplies, and adapt as lava flows and fire reshape the terrain you’ve just visited.

Use retro-inspired rescue technology: suppression pistols, extinguishing shotguns, and ziplines to control the flames, and carve new escape routes. Balance risk and reward. Go deeper for more lives, or retreat before the inferno traps you.

No two extractions unfold the same way.

  • System-driven fire behavior and evolving terrain.

  • Resource management under constant pressure.

  • Replayable extraction missions with changing conditions.

DISCOVER BURNING MYTHS

Set on a volcanic island inspired by real-world fire zones and mythologies, Into The Fire blends scientific realism with ancient belief. Fire anomalies, forgotten rituals, and unsettling legends blur the line between natural disaster and ancient beliefs. 

Retro-futuristic rescue technology contrasts with ritual and sacred temples, abandoned cable stations, and ash-covered villages. The island is not just collapsing. It is transforming.

What began as an eruption may be something more.

  • Volcanic island setting grounded in real phenomena.

  • Mystical fire anomalies and environmental storytelling.

  • The history of the island is discovered through exploration and rescue.

EXPLORE VARIOUS LOCATIONS

Discover the destructive yet creative power of the volcano. It reveals the map before you, new paths, and with them, mysterious buried places. Large, semi-open districts evolve with escalating catastrophe. Lava blocks familiar paths. Bridges collapse. Ash buries entire streets. Entire structures become accessible or are permanently lost

Plan routes, discover safe zones and secure extraction points. Return to altered areas with better tools and new strategies.

Volcano is the main force that carves the world and changes it’s layout. 

  • Semi-open disaster zones shaped by the wrath of nature 

  • Environmental hazards reshape your gameplay

  • Areas evolve between runs

INTO THE FIRE - KEY GAME FEATURES

  • High-risk cataclysm extraction survival focused on rescuing others and gathering loot

  • Dynamic volcanic disaster with pyroclastic flows, seismic shocks, and dynamic fire behavior

  • HUB progression is shaped by the survivors you bring back and the decisions you make

  • Retro-designed extinguishing tools and rescue equipment 

  • Semi-open districts that evolve during the cataclysm
